mapper.select: select subscription_id, user_id, name, amount, cycle_type, cycle_interval, next_renew_date, first_anchor_date, trial_end_date, auto_renew, status, cancel_url, cancel_steps, remind_days_before, note, created_at, updated_at from user_subscription where status = 'active' and next_renew_date <= date_add(#{today}, interval remind_days_before day) order by next_renew_date

select subscription_id, user_id, name, amount, cycle_type, cycle_interval, next_renew_date, first_anchor_date, trial_end_date, auto_renew, status, cancel_url, cancel_steps, remind_days_before, note, created_at, updated_at from user_subscription where status = 'active' and trial_end_date = #{today} order by subscription_id
